# @dxtmisha/ui

> Complete DXT UI design system meta-package.

Bundles all essential packages into a single dependency: `@dxtmisha/constructor`, `@dxtmisha/functional`, `@dxtmisha/styles`, `@dxtmisha/media`, `@dxtmisha/wiki`, `@dxtmisha/configuration`, and `@dxtmisha/scripts`.

## Included Libraries

- [@dxtmisha/constructor](../constructor/llms.txt): Headless UI component constructors and ARIA accessibility.
- [@dxtmisha/functional](../functional/llms.txt): Vue 3 composables, reactive storage, and API singletons.
- [@dxtmisha/styles](../styles/llms.txt): SCSS design tokens, mixins, and CSS variables.
- [@dxtmisha/media](../media/llms.txt): SVG country flags and geographical metadata.
- [@dxtmisha/wiki](../wiki/llms.txt): Storybook documentation toolkit and MDX content.
- [@dxtmisha/configuration](../configuration/llms.txt): Vite and TypeScript build presets.
- [@dxtmisha/scripts](../scripts/llms.txt): CLI tools and component scaffolding scripts.

## Optional

- [README.md](README.md): Comprehensive design system overview, installation, and usage guides.
- [package.json](package.json): Package dependencies and peer requirements.
